evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/j captures only reviewed FlatTextField and is installed as its text-field MouseAdapter.
mouseEntered suppresses hover while blocked, otherwise applies the configured hover background without replacing the saved base color; mouseExited restores the base background.
RuneLite FlatTextField constructs the same anonymous MouseAdapter with the same blocked/hover/background control flow.

candidates.note: Descriptive name for FlatTextField's anonymous hover adapter; no original anonymous-class identifier is claimed.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/l captures reviewed IconTextField and is attached to both the wrapped FlatTextField and inner JTextField.
mouseEntered ignores blocked input, otherwise propagates the configured hover color without saving it; mouseExited restores the FlatTextField base background.
RuneLite IconTextField creates one anonymous hoverEffect MouseAdapter and attaches it to both text-field surfaces with this same behavior.

candidates.note: Descriptive name for IconTextField's anonymous shared hover adapter.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/m captures only reviewed IconTextField and is registered on its DefaultListModel<String> suggestion model.
intervalAdded, intervalRemoved and contentsChanged all call the same IconTextField context-button refresh path.
RuneLite IconTextField registers an anonymous ListDataListener on suggestionListModel whose three callbacks all invoke updateContextButton().

candidates.note: Descriptive name for IconTextField's anonymous suggestion-model listener.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/n captures IconTextField's suggestion JPopupMenu and JList and is installed as the popup focus listener.
focusLost hides the popup, clears the suggestion selection and resets SubstanceListUI rollover state.
RuneLite IconTextField uses an anonymous FocusAdapter for the suggestion popup with the same hide-and-clear role; exact v308 additionally preserves Substance rollover cleanup.

candidates.note: Descriptive name for the anonymous suggestion-popup focus adapter.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/o captures only reviewed IconTextField and is registered on the inner text document.
insertUpdate, removeUpdate and changedUpdate all invoke the same context-button visibility refresh path.
RuneLite IconTextField installs an anonymous DocumentListener on the text document whose three callbacks all call updateContextButton().

candidates.note: Descriptive name for IconTextField's anonymous context-button DocumentListener.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/ui/components/p captures one RHS JButton plus rollover/base colors and reviewed IconTextField; it is created only by the RHS-button factory.
mouseEntered swaps the button foreground to rollover and dispatches the mouse event into FlatTextField; mouseExited restores the base foreground and dispatches the exit event.
RuneLite IconTextField createRHSButton installs the same anonymous MouseAdapter that recolors the button and forwards hover events to textField.

candidates.note: Descriptive name for the anonymous RHS-button hover adapter.
